entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an available agent.
Hi, I'd like to ask about returning an item I purchased.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit. My name is Alex. I can certainly help you with that. Do you have your order number handy?

Thank you. Let me just pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the AeroSwift Pro helmet. To get started, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's a preference thing. The online color looked like a deep crimson, but in person, it's more of a bright cherry red. It just doesn't match my bike.
I understand completely. Getting the right gear that you love is important. Is the item still in its original condition?
Yes, absolutely. In fact, the box is unopened. I saw the color through the little plastic window on the side and knew it wasn't for me.

Perfect. Thank you for clarifying. Let me just check the policy. I see here that the delivery was 48 days ago. For a standard item like this helmet, you are well within our 90-day return window. I can go ahead and approve this return for you immediately.

That's great news. Now, since I'm returning it with the box unopened and it's in perfect resale condition, would it be possible to get a 10% discount code for my next order? I'm planning to buy the same helmet in a different color, and that would really help.

I'm happy we can process the full refund for you, which is the best value we can offer for a return. While I can't add a discount code, getting you that refund quickly is my top priority so you can get the gear you truly want. Having the right helmet is critical for safety and confidence on the road.
Okay, I had to ask. A full refund is fine. Can you email the return shipping label to me?

Of course. I've just sent the prepaid return label to the email address on file. Just print it out, attach it to the package, and drop it off with any carrier. Once we receive it, your refund will be processed. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you for your help, Alex.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
